name: Suzumemo (kakeibo)
install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://mise.run | sh; fi; mise install; mise exec -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
start: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; mise exec -- sh -c 'export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous; pnpm exec convex dev --once || true; pnpm exec convex env get CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm exec convex env set CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN "https://example-dev.clerk.accounts.dev" || true; pnpm exec convex env get APP_ENV >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm exec convex env set APP_ENV development || true; pnpm exec convex env get RECEIPT_IMAGE_EXTRACTOR_MODE >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm exec convex env set RECEIPT_IMAGE_EXTRACTOR_MODE mock || true; pnpm exec convex dev --once || true'

terminals.name: convex
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && export CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous && exec mise exec -- pnpm exec convex dev

terminals.name: vite
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && exec mise exec -- pnpm exec vite --host 127.0.0.1
